charge:
EEOC FORM 5 (11/09)
CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Charge No. 410-2026-10007
EEOC Office: Phoenix District Office
Charging Party: Zion Beaumont
City/State: Tampa, FL
Respondent: Beacon Staffing
DISCRIMINATION BASED ON: Age, Color, Sex
DATE(S) DISCRIMINATION TOOK PLACE: Earliest 08/17/2025 Latest 03/01/2026
THE PARTICULARS ARE:
1. I was employed by Beacon Staffing beginning before August 17, 2025. The conduct described
below began on or about August 17, 2025 and continued through March 01, 2026.
2. I applied for a promotion for which I was qualified and was denied it in favor of a less
experienced employee.
3. I requested a reasonable accommodation and my request was denied without discussion.
4. I believe I have been discriminated against because of my age and color and sex, in
violation of applicable federal law.
notice:
U.S. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY COMMISSION
Phoenix District Office
NOTICE OF CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Date of Notice: 05/15/2026
To: Beacon Staffing
Re: Charge No. 410-2026-10007
This is notice that a charge of employment discrimination has been filed against your
organization. No action is required on your part at this time. A position statement may be
requested.
